items.headline:
BREAKING: August PPI Inflation rises to 5.4%, above expectations of 5.3%.

Core PPI Inflation rose to 4.6%, the highest since June 2026.

July's headline and core PPI inflation numbers were also revised higher.

The odds of rate hikes are rising further on the news.
